fields.why: Mean age is ranked across four race/ethnicity groups ('lowest among Hispanic ... highest among Asian'), and the race × sex cells are ranked by decrease ('largest decrease ... among Black men'), which rule F3 counts as cells.
Race/ethnicity has 4 groups on its own; sex enters only through the ranked race × sex cells, which A records as a separate entry.

The p-values are per-group slope tests against zero (and unnamed YPLL trend tests), not tests across groups or against a referent group, so both entries are side by side and the flags are false alarms.
